kidney_left.scope: Left kidney hilar exterior. Retains capsule, outer cortex and hilum. Internal renal columns, papillae and pyramids remain in the full atlas.

kidney_right.scope: Right kidney hilar exterior. Retains capsule, outer cortex and hilum. Internal renal columns, papillae and pyramids remain in the full atlas.

placenta.scope: Fetal and maternal surface orientation. Retains the cord, amnion, chorionic and basal plates and placental vessels. Three internal cord vessel meshes remain in the full atlas.

lung_pair.scope: Bilateral lobe orientation. Retains all five lobar groups, all their segments and hila. The separate tracheobronchial selection remains in the full atlas.
